title: Subjunctive Mood - Present and Imperfect
objectives: Form the present subjunctive for all conjugations
Form the imperfect subjunctive for all conjugations
Recognize independent uses: hortatory, jussive, optative
Understand the subjunctive as mood of possibility/wish
Use the subjunctive in main clauses

grammar.topic: Subjunctive Mood - Formation and Independent Uses
grammar.explanation: The subjunctive expresses actions that are possible, wished, commanded, or hypothetical rather than actual. In main clauses, it expresses commands (jussive), wishes (optative), or exhortations (hortatory).
rules: Present subjunctive: 1st conj changes vowel; others add -a-
Negative: use ne (not non) with independent subjunctives

exercises.question: Form the present subjunctive 3rd singular of 'venio'

readingPassage.latin: Gaudeamus, amici! Vita brevis est. Bibamus et cantemus! Utinam semper felices simus. Ne laboremus hodie. Cras laborabimus.
readingPassage.translation: Let us rejoice, friends! Life is short. Let us drink and sing! May we always be happy. Let us not work today. Tomorrow we shall work.
notes: Series of hortatory and optative subjunctives
